title: Instant Oatmeal, plain, made with water

content.title: About
content.content: Instant oatmeal consists of whole oat groats that have been steamed and cut into small flakes so they dissolve quickly in hot water. The product contains no added fat, sugar, or flavorings, providing a pure source of complex carbohydrates.

content.title: Interesting Facts
items: Oats are one of the oldest cultivated grains, grown for more than 5,000 years.
Instant oatmeal can be prepared in 1–2 minutes, making it popular with students and travelers.
Oats belong to the grass family and are close relatives of wheat and barley.
Oat flakes are used not only in food but also in cosmetics for scrubs and masks.
In the United States, over 30 % of the population eats oatmeal for breakfast regularly.

items.title: High in fiber
items.content: Both soluble and insoluble fiber improve digestion, promote satiety, and help regulate blood sugar levels.

items.title: Source of beta‑glucan
items.content: Beta‑glucan lowers LDL cholesterol and supports the immune system.

items.title: Contains B‑vitamins
items.content: B1, B5 and folate are involved in energy metabolism and nervous‑system health.

items.title: Minerals: iron and magnesium
items.content: Iron is essential for oxygen transport, while magnesium supports muscle and nerve function.

items.title: Low in fat
items.content: The absence of added fat makes it suitable for calorie‑controlled diets.

items.title: Oat allergy
items.content: A small number of people may experience allergic reactions to oats or oat proteins.

items.title: Gluten cross‑contamination
items.content: Oats are often processed on the same lines as wheat, so gluten contamination is possible.

items.title: Phytic acid
items.content: Phytates can reduce the absorption of certain minerals when consumed in large amounts.

content.title: How to Eat
content.content: Pour 200 ml of boiling water over the oatmeal, stir, and let stand for 1–2 minutes. You can add berries, nuts, honey, or protein powder. Use less water for a thicker consistency.

content.title: Storage
content.content: Store in a cool, dry place in a tightly sealed package. After opening, use within 1–2 weeks to prevent moisture absorption and loss of crisp texture.
